lines: Yeh alag baat hai, saqi, ke mujhe hosh nahin
couplets.en: It is another matter, cupbearer, that I have lost my senses.

lines: Warna main kuchh bhi hoon, ehsaan-faramosh nahin
couplets.en: Whatever else I may be, I remember what I owe.

lines: Main teri mast nigahi ka bharam rakh loonga
couplets.en: I will keep the secret of what your gaze can do.

lines: Hosh aaya bhi to keh doonga, mujhe hosh nahin
couplets.en: Even if I come to my senses, I will say I am still beside myself.

lines: Saqi, sharaab la ke tabiyat udaas hai
couplets.en: Cupbearer, bring me wine, for my heart is low.

lines: Mutrib, rabaab utha ke tabiyat udaas hai
couplets.en: Musician, take up your rabab, for my heart is low.

lines: Saqi, sharaab la ke tabiyat udaas hai
couplets.en: Cupbearer, bring me wine, for my heart is low.

lines: Mutrib, rabaab utha ke tabiyat udaas hai
couplets.en: Musician, take up your rabab, for my heart is low.

lines: Chubhti hai qalb-o-jaan mein sitaaron ki roshni
couplets.en: The light of the stars pierces heart and soul.

lines: Ai chaand, doob ja ke tabiyat udaas hai
couplets.en: Moon, sink from sight, for my heart is low.

lines: Hai husn ka fusoon bhi ilaaj-e-fasurdagi
couplets.en: Beauty has a spell that can lift this melancholy.

lines: Rukh se naqaab utha ke tabiyat udaas hai
couplets.en: Lift the veil from your face, for my heart is low.

lines: Hai husn ka fusoon bhi ilaaj-e-fasurdagi
couplets.en: Beauty has a spell that can lift this melancholy.

lines: Rukh se naqaab utha ke tabiyat udaas hai
couplets.en: Lift the veil from your face, for my heart is low.

lines: Shaayad tere labon ki chatak se ho ji bahaal
couplets.en: Perhaps the first stir of your lips will revive my spirits.

lines: Ai dost, muskura ke tabiyat udaas hai
couplets.en: Smile, dear friend, for my heart is low.

lines: Maine kabhi yeh zid to nahin ki, par aaj shab
couplets.en: I have never insisted before, but tonight I will.

lines: Ai mah-jabeen, na ja ke tabiyat udaas hai
couplets.en: Stay, moon-browed one, for my heart is low.

lines: Tauba to kar chuka hoon, magar phir bhi, ai Adam
couplets.en: I have already repented, and yet, Adam, here I am.

lines: Tauba to kar chuka hoon, magar phir bhi, ai Adam
couplets.en: I have already repented, and yet, Adam, here I am.

lines: Thoda sa zehr la ke tabiyat udaas hai
couplets.en: Bring me a little poison, for my heart is low.

couplets.en: Musician, take up your rabab, for my heart is low.
